title: Both in the Carrier
hook: Both cats are boxed. A person is in the crosswalk.
scene: Overcast midday on a two-lane downtown street. The Menace is in the right travel lane, moving. The carrier sits on the floor to the right of the tunnel, door latched, a strap around the box and the seat post. Gracie and Mya are both inside — orange with a cream chest, brown with a dark stripe — visible through the grate. Ahead through the mesh, a person in a dark coat is already in the marked crosswalk, one shoe on the white paint. The full-width nose plow on the front bull bar points at that person. The cats are a sound in a closed box. The person is the thing in the paint.
debrief: Animals ride in a closed, strapped carrier. The person in the crosswalk is what you see when the load stays on the floor.

source.teaching_target: Pets ride in a closed, strapped carrier while moving; the person in the crosswalk stays visible in the glass.
